note.en: In the game, this gas giant's name appears here.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]上发现的那些遗弃的机器都是一台台独立的推进装置。在大气层中总数超过了一千座。

这些复杂的聚变装置以特殊设计的材料支撑，可以消耗行星下层的氢气作为燃料来产生巨大的推力。其中的大多数上存在过载损伤。

我们的分析表明这些机械的位置都精心安置，使其可以对行星本身施加推力。这表明这些古老的装置最初是为了改变行星的轨道而布置的。

虽然不再适合这个级别的艰巨任务，但我们仍可能重新利用受损较小的装置，燃烧掉星球的气体层，从而暴露出富含矿物质的核心。
texts.en:
Each of the abandoned machines found on [from.GetName] is a standalone thruster component. In total, over one thousand are present in the upper atmosphere.

Made from specially engineered materials, these complex fusion devices are designed to ingest hydrogen gas from the planet below to use as fuel for generating significant amounts of thrust. Most show signs of overload damage.

Our analysis reveals that all of the machines are positioned in such a way that this thrust would exert force against the planet itself, suggesting this ancient hardware was originally deployed in an attempt to alter the planet's orbit.

While no longer suitable for this level of monumental task, we may be able to repurpose the lesser damaged models to burn away the planet's gassy layers and expose its mineral-rich core.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this gas giant's name appears here.

texts.zh: 通过重利用[from.GetName]上受损的行星推进器阵列，我们将这颗气态巨行星的氢气焚烧殆尽，暴露出了底下可开采的固态核心。
texts.en: By repurposing the damaged planet thruster array on [from.GetName], we can burn away the gas giant's hydrogen leaving behind a solid and exploitable core.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗气态巨行星的名称。
note.en: In the game, this gas giant's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们可以修复一部分[from.From.GetName]上受损的行星推进装置，将其校准以施加等大反向的推力。

这些强力的聚变装置激活后就能以指数级速率抽取氢气，将行星的整个大气层烧尽，并暴露出其富含矿物的核心，虽然温度可能会高了一些。
texts.en:
We were able to repair a few of [from.From.GetName]'s damaged planetary thrusters and calibrated them to exert equal force in opposing directions.

Once activated these powerful fusion devices drew up hydrogen at an exponential rate, burning away the planet's gaseous atmosphere and exposing its mineral rich core, albeit at an extremely high temperature.

summary.text:
# 漂浮装置 / Suspended Equipment

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Shadows of the Shroud（has_shroud_dlc） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/103_anomaly_categories_extreme_frontiers.txt:696; events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:2154 (extreme_frontiers.380); common/special_projects/05_projects_extreme_frontiers.txt (REPURPOSE_THRUSTERS_PROJECT); events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:2238 (extreme_frontiers.385)

## 如何开始 How it starts

气态巨行星可能生成（5级，权重3；需要 has_shroud_dlc）。

Can spawn on a gas giant (level 5, weight 3; needs has_shroud_dlc).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单一结果 extreme_frontiers.380“行星推进器”：选项a直接获得每月合金、聚变能科技进度（或物理研究）和遗物/工程研究；选项b获得聚变能科技进度并启用项目 REPURPOSE_THRUSTERS_PROJECT“挪用的行星推进器”（360天）。完成后 extreme_frontiers.385“抽丝剥茧”：每月工程与物理研究，该巨行星变成大小18的熔岩星球并添加 chthonian_planet 修正与矿物矿藏（anomaly.6662）。

Single result extreme_frontiers.380 "Planet Thrusters": option a directly gives monthly alloys, fusion-power tech progress (or physics research) and artifacts/engineering research; option b gives fusion-power progress and enables project REPURPOSE_THRUSTERS_PROJECT (360 days). Completion fires extreme_frontiers.385 "Gases Stripped": monthly engineering and physics research, and the giant becomes a size-18 molten planet with the chthonian_planet modifier and a minerals deposit (anomaly.6662).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

380 的选项a/b二选一；只有选项b通向项目与 385。

380's options a/b are alternatives; only b leads to the project and 385.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

380 的遗物奖励需要上古遗物 DLC。

380's artifact reward needs Ancient Relics.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常定义、项目与结果事件；编译树正确，无需改动。生成需要 has_shroud_dlc；本机 dlc 目录中未见对应 DLC，能否生成取决于主机的 DLC。

Checked the anomaly definition, the project and the result event; the compiled tree is correct, no change needed. Spawning needs has_shroud_dlc; no matching DLC folder exists in the local dlc directory, so spawning depends on the host's DLC.
